text: Derived stats ignore data.characterValues on purpose. These are DDB's per-character customization entries. Their typeIds are undocumented: one real character had six typeId 39 rows (valueId 1-6 = stat IDs, notes 'Epic item') and one typeId 25 row, and we could not confirm what they do. The ability score, AC and HP calculations matched the DDB website without them. Decode them against the website before using them.
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>
